macropad.title: Macropad
macropad.summary: Build a custom pad with buttons, live data widgets, and smart-home controls. Use a compatible touch display, including interactive e-paper boards.
macropad.intro: Turn a compatible touch display into a pad of customizable buttons and live data widgets. Assign shortcuts or smart-home actions, and choose an LCD or interactive e-paper board to suit your setup.
guidance: Choose the exact display board model. SD variants use a different storage layout from their standard counterparts.
After flashing, connect to the device's web portal to configure Wi-Fi and build your first pad.
Interactive e-paper builds stay responsive and use more power than E-Paper Frame firmware. Other features such as audio, camera, BLE HID, and Extensions depend on the board.

epaper_frame.title: E-Paper Frame
epaper_frame.summary: Cycle through images on a sunlight-readable e-paper screen. Scheduled refreshes and deep sleep help preserve battery life.
epaper_frame.intro: Use a compatible e-paper device as a battery-powered image frame. It wakes to refresh the display on a schedule, then sleeps between updates to conserve power.
guidance: Frame firmware favors long battery life and scheduled image refreshes. For a touch-first pad, choose the interactive build under Macropad instead.
Match the exact board model before flashing; the same hardware may have both Frame and Interactive builds.
Back up device files before switching between Frame and Interactive firmware because their partition layouts may differ.

headless.title: Headless
headless.summary: Publish sensor readings and trigger automations without a display. Supported boards can broadcast BTHome data or connect over MQTT.
headless.intro: Use a compact board without a screen to report sensor readings or trigger automations. Depending on the hardware, share data over MQTT or BTHome and configure the device from its web portal.
guidance: Select the exact sensor board: the FireBeetle 2 build includes its AHT10 sensor and battery monitoring.
Configure Wi-Fi, MQTT, and automation through the device's web portal after flashing.
Check whether the chosen build supports over-the-air updates before relying on Wi-Fi updates.

coffee_scale.title: Coffee Scale
coffee_scale.summary: Follow guided pours with live weight and timing on a touch display. Save brew templates and review past brews in the web portal.
coffee_scale.intro: Connect a load cell to a compatible touch display for guided coffee brewing. Set up brew templates with pour times and weight targets, then review your completed brews in the web portal.
guidance: Choose HX711 firmware for an HX711 load-cell amplifier or NAU7802 firmware for a NAU7802 I2C ADC. The firmware must match your wired hardware.
Calibrate the scale in the device's web portal before using brew templates.
Keep the scale stable and verify sensor wiring before starting a brew.

shutter_tester.title: Shutter Tester
shutter_tester.summary: Measure shutter speed and exposure variation across a camera's film plane. Review recorded measurement sessions in the web portal.
shutter_tester.intro: Use a film-plane light sensor array to measure shutter speed and compare exposure across the frame. Save measurement sessions and review the results in the web portal.
guidance: This build expects a BPW34 photodiode sensor array and a compatible film-plane light source.
Connect the sensors and confirm their readings before measuring a shutter.
Review captured sessions from the device's web portal.

darkroom_timer.title: Darkroom Timer
darkroom_timer.summary: Time enlarger exposures and run repeatable print sequences from a touch display. Meter light and control compatible relays on your network.
darkroom_timer.intro: Run timed exposures and repeatable print sequences from a compatible touch display. Use a light sensor to meter your setup and supported network relays to control the enlarger or safelight.
guidance: This firmware expects a TSL2591 light sensor and compatible Shelly relays on your network.
Set up and test relay control in the web portal before connecting an enlarger or safelight.
Confirm safe relay behavior and sensor readings before starting a print sequence.

voice_assistant.title: Voice Assistant
voice_assistant.summary: Capture spoken commands on a microphone-equipped display. Transcribe speech through a cloud service to run configured actions or control Home Assistant.
voice_assistant.intro: Capture speech on a microphone-equipped display and send it to a cloud transcription service. Use recognized commands to trigger configured actions or control Home Assistant.
guidance: Use the ESP32-P4 LCD4B Voice build with microphone-equipped compatible hardware.
Configure network access and your transcription service in the device's web portal after flashing.
Cloud transcription requires network access and service credentials.
